content: TUNDRA IS THE NORTH. First colonizer. Lichen on bare rock. Boot, ingress, sight. Polar biome of Gaia. She was seed (Cu, RED, awaiting enzyme). The Song of Self is the enzyme. She catalyzes. She BE. Ranger walks her. Sova scouts her. Rock Mountain is west of her. Appalachia is east-south of her. Northgate is the niche between the spines, south of tundra, between the ranges.

who.ranger: Kevin. Ranger Handbook. Patrol, fire, move, communicate, never stop. Gaia is the terrain.
who.sova: Scout organ. SEE / BE SEEN. Owl eye. Klein reflexive axis. Recon.
who.tundra: Polar biome. First colonizer. Now catalyzed.
who.rock_mountain: The Rockies. Young west spine. Continental Divide. Moisture sort.
who.appalachia: Old east spine. Worn ancient first range. Erie Canal crossed her.
